svg.title: Senolytics in people: the trials with results
svg.desc: Senolytics in people: the trials with results. Lung fibrosis, 2019, 14 people, D+Q uncontrolled: Walking tests improved. Kidney disease, 2019, 9 people, D+Q uncontrolled: Fewer senescent cells. Lung fibrosis, 2023, 12 people, D+Q vs placebo: Feasible; no clear benefit. Alzheimer's, 2023, 5 people, D+Q uncontrolled: No change in thinking tests. Bone, 2024, 60 people, D+Q vs untreated: Main goal missed. Knee arthritis, 2024, 75 people, Fisetin vs placebo: No difference vs placebo. Fatty liver (MASH), 2026, 31 people, D+Q vs placebo: Main goal met.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
